tez: Costco Wholesale Corporation demonstrates robust financial performance with strong top-line and bottom-line growth, backed by high-quality earnings and excellent liquidity. In fiscal Q3 2026 YTD, revenue grew 9.7% YoY to $207,431.0 million, operating profit rose 12.0% YoY to $7,884.0 million, net profit increased 13.5% YoY to $6,228.0 million, and operating cash flow grew 17.6% YoY to $11,133.0 million. Costco maintains a strong cash position of $18,946.0 million compared to $5,670.0 million in noncurrent financial debt, providing substantial balance sheet flexibility and risk mitigation. Supported by a Piotroski F-score of 7/9 and a 62.46% return on tangible operating capital, Costco's business model delivers durable cash generation and consistent compounding.
